notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
[Major-Enough update]
- Stage on New Game + now rotated (except Boss Stages)
- Costume for Mira, Daria, and Irvette added. They just change your appearance, won't affect your power.
- Lumina and Yoruko upgraded with some unique ability

[b] Bug might appear because of this update [/b]

Feel free to report on Forum Discussion, or at here

notes.title: Update 1.0.5.3
notes.content:
Many update happened since 1.0.4, but here is the important things:

- Change how the game handle memory, now it is more smoother
- Fix crash bug at Mac OSX
- Added Steam Achievement refresh button (in case you completed Boss Challenge without internet connection)
and some stage design changes so the secret is more visible, and many bug fixes.
- Boss Rush now unlocked when all other challenges are unlocked.
No need to clear Bonus Game anymore (Bonus Game would be just a bonus)

Thanks for the report and feedback~
Hope you enjoyed the game^^

notes.content:
- Experimental fix for this issue :
http://steamcommunity.com/app/395140/discussions/0/492378806382928026/

[strike]Step on the link is needed to follow [/strike] (which also mean Steam Cloud is disabled if you're having this issue), sorry about that.
